description: This file defines the interface for network I/O operations in the lighttpd project, including function declarations for reading, writing, and using system-specific sendfile optimizations.

methods.name: li_network_error_quark
methods.description: Returns the GQuark for network-related errors used throughout the lighttpd network module.

methods.name: li_net_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation on a file descriptor, handling interruptions and errors.

methods.name: li_net_read
methods.description: Performs a read operation on a file descriptor, handling interruptions and errors.

methods.name: li_network_write
methods.description: Writes data from a chunk queue to a network socket, up to a maximum byte count.

methods.name: li_network_read
methods.description: Reads data from a network socket into a chunk queue and buffer, up to a maximum byte count.

methods.name: li_network_write_writev
methods.description: Performs a writev-based write operation using a chunk queue.

methods.name: li_network_write_sendfile
methods.description: Uses sendfile for file data transfer if available, otherwise falls back to other methods.

methods.name: li_network_backend_write
methods.description: Performs a backend write to a network socket with fallback handling.

methods.name: li_network_backend_writev
methods.description: Performs a vectorized backend write to a network socket.
